background.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. Pure white/black maximize contrast (21:1) instead of referencing the gray scale.

foreground.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. 21:1 on background.

muted.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. Text stays pure black rather than gray, so muted surfaces don't need a dimmer foreground to read as 'muted'.

muted-foreground.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. 16.96:1 on muted; see muted above.

border.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. 21:1 on background, far above the 3:1 non-text minimum (WCAG 1.4.11).

ring.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. 9.46:1 on background; a distinct hue from the black border/text so focus is still visible as a separate signal.

accent.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. A solid near-black block instead of a subtle tint, so the accented state stays unambiguous.

accent-foreground.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. 17.74:1 on accent.

destructive.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. Darker than light.json's destructive for extra margin.

destructive-foreground.$description: New theme, not present in @mild-ui/core. 6.47:1 on destructive.
